protocol: phase2_addressing_probe: supervised multi-slot content-addressing probe over K in {2,4,8}, goal-modulated vs plain read. Bayes-posterior-supervised answer logits on query frames. reliability 0.9, slots 16, 400-800 train steps.
conclusion: Goal-modulated content addressing (query X one-hot modulates the read query) is measurably more precise than a plain read: gap goal-off ~0.22-0.30 across K. The gap does NOT close as K grows (K8 gap 0.297). This is the first direct evidence that JEPLMMemory can address a specific slot among many when the query names the target -- DecideStream only ever exercised most-recent recall.
